thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Elevated 5xx rate detected on prod gateway (service=redwood-gateway-prod). Threshold: 5xx > 3% over 2m. Top errors: 502, 504, upstream reset. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd123/gateway-5xx
oncall-eng: oncall-eng here, taking the page. will start triage and gather quick metrics.
matt: I can see a config rollout for lb-config-pr-402 at 01:57 UTC. changed retries/backoff and a route weight tweak. suspicious timing.
sara: Confirming — overall median latency steady but tail and 5xx jumped ~02:00 UTC. Envoy logs show "upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers" for several upstreams.
elaine: Running quick checks: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=gateway -o wide` -> all pods Ready, no OOMs.
eng-sre: Early hypothesis: retry policy plus aggressive backoff might be amplifying upstream flakiness -> retry amplification -> circuit breakers trip -> 502/504 cascade. Suggest disabling retries on gateway per-route temporarily.
matt: here's the rollout diff snippet I pulled from the PR:
```
# envoy route snippet
retry_policy:
  retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused-stream
  num_retries: 3
  per_try_timeout: 1000ms
```
That per_try_timeout looks low and combined with retries could be harmful.
sara: Quick repro: `curl -v https://gateway.prod/api/health` against lb instance A -> 502, instance B -> 200. inconsistent routing.
oncall-eng: I'm pausing the rollout and rolling back the LB config immediately. Command: `kubectl -n infra apply -f /manifests/lb-config/rollback-20260315.yaml` executing now.
devops-bot: Deploy rollback triggered by oncall-eng. CI job 8421 started. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/rollbacks/8421
incident-bot: Update: rollback applied to ~30% of shards. 5xx rate decreased from 4.6% -> 2.1% within 3m.
matt: While rollback propagates, shifting some weight off the most-affected shard. Traffic-control command (internal): `trafficctl set-weight gateway /completion shard-3 0.7 -> 0.4` to relieve shard-3.
elaine: Also bumping circuit-breaker thresholds temporarily to reduce hard tripping: `max_connections 2000 -> 4000`, `max_pending_requests 500 -> 1000`. Will monitor.
eng-sre: Keep an eye on retry amplification and backend latency — if retries keep firing we'll still see load. Recommend disabling retries entirely until we confirm backend stability.
customer-success: What is customer impact? any high-traffic endpoints affected?
sara: Impacted endpoints: /chat/completions and /stream for NA region. Traffic sample shows ~15% of requests in NA experienced 5xx during peak.
oncall-eng: Posting a short status: "Investigating elevated 5xx rates affecting chat/completions in NA. Mitigation in progress: partial rollback and traffic shift. Next update in 10m." Will post to status.redwood.example now.
sara: Traces show connect timeouts originating at LB->upstream for host shard-3. Looks like a routing imbalance.
matt: Root cause hypothesis: the recent LB retry/backoff change amplified intermittent upstream connection failures, causing connection churn and CB fallout.
eng-sre: Followups to prevent recurrence: add canary gate for retry/backoff changes (percent + time-window thresholds), increase per_try_timeout for long-tail backends, instrument per-shard health checks and circuit-breaker metrics.
oncall-eng: Current metric: last 5m 5xx = 1.8% (down from 4.6%). I'll continue to monitor and keep this thread open. Handoff to day SRE at 07:00 local; runbook: https://wiki.redwood.example/runbooks/gateway-5xx. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident created INC-20260315-042. Severity: SEV3. Ops incident channel: #inc-INC-20260315-042 created.
customer-success: Notifying top impacted customers now via DM and will update the public status page once stable.
matt: after stabilization we should run a post-mortem focusing on rollout safeguards and default retry config.
oncall-eng: Agreed. I will create a follow-up ticket and assign leads. Leaving monitoring alarms at elevated sensitivity until tomorrow.
eng-sre: Good job team. Please add any logs/traces to the incident doc before closing.
sara: I'll attach a handful of traces and spike graphs to the incident doc.
elaine: Rolling back complete for all shards. Observed 5xx back to baseline ~0.9%.
oncall-eng: Closing the page: will keep incident open for postmortem work. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
